register_env: register a new environment family with a make_env_func and optional CLI parameter functions
register_env_deferred: register an environment family with deferred initialization that imports modules only when needed
resolve_env_name: resolve a full environment name to its registered EnvRegistryEntry by matching the name prefix
register_default_envs: register all default environment families including doom, atari, dmlab, mujoco, and minigrid
global_env_registry: get the singleton global EnvRegistry instance, initializing it with default envs if needed
